nina-peopleops: Quick thread on an unusual midcycle leveling + comp change for Priya (APAC, SG-based). Omar filed SWE II -> SWE III with a 4/1 effective and asked for retro to 3/15 — payroll cutoff concerns?
omar-eng-manager: Hi! We need the salary bump reflected ASAP; manager evidence and org signoff uploaded. Title change also impacts on-call banding.
nina-peopleops: Two streams: payroll timing + any on-call stipend change approvals. Lucy, SG payroll partner cutoff?
lucy-payroll: SG local feed cutoff is 23rd SGT. If we submit before then, change can be included with effective 3/15. Otherwise we do a retro correction next month. Note: retro will show as separate adjustment and affect CPF-equivalent local contributions.
zhach-recruiter: (zach-recruiter) small note: if title changes banding for salary bands, comp committee wants the leveling memo. That usually takes ~2 business days.
comp-bot: Reminder: Submit international retro form: https://internal.forms/sg-retro. Use code SG-RETRO-2026.
nina-peopleops: Practical ask: Omar paste single-line rationale here, confirm numbers (old/new annual), and confirm whether to include on-call stipend change now or defer to next payroll.
omar-eng-manager: Rationale: "Promoted for expanding ownership of infra reliability and on-call escalation handling." Numbers: previous 96,000 SGD -> new 110,000 SGD. On-call stipend: increase from 500 -> 700 SGD monthly; prefer to include stipend change now.
lucy-payroll: OK, include both base + stipend if submitted before cutoff. Please attach signed manager doc + org approval in the retro form. Submission will generate payroll ticket PAY-SG-2026-22.
nina-peopleops: Also note equity: comp committee will size grant later; mark equity defer. Omar please attach leveling memo for committee.
omar-eng-manager: Done, memo uploaded.
lu cy-payroll: Created ticket PAY-SG-2026-22 after receiving form. Expect processing ETA 3 business days. I'll post updates in folder.
nina-peopleops: Thanks everyone. Action items: Omar -> confirm form uploaded (done), Lucy -> proceed with payroll ticket, Comp -> size grant later. Re-open if any exceptions.
